'''Pokémon Adventures: Saffron City Showdown''' is the fourteenth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters thirty-two and thirty-three of the {{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{PAV|3}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

==Important events==
* {{Adv|Green}} steals the {{Badge|Marsh}} from [[Sabrina]] and gives it to {{adv|Red}}.
* {{Adv|Red}}, {{Adv|Green}}, and {{Adv|Blue}} defeat [[Team Rocket]] in [[Saffron City]].
* {{Adv|Red}}'s [[Moon Stone]] evolves Green's {{p|Clefairy}}, Clefy, into {{p|Clefable}}.
* Red's {{p|Ivysaur}}, [[Saur]], evolves into {{p|Venusaur}}.
